tagline: 禄来胶片相机，1976 年发布
description: 禄来于1976年推出的胶片相机。配备Rollei Tessar f=23mm f/2.8 - f/16 (focusing 1 meter to infinity)。快门速度electronically controlled Rollei-Prontor leaf shutter (continuous speeds from 4 - 1/250 sec.)。使用Type 110 cartridges for 16mm film (13x17mm image) with speeds of 100 or 400 ASA selected by film cartridge notch。

specs.胶片/画幅: Type 110 cartridges for 16mm film (13x17mm image) with speeds of 100 or 400 ASA selected by film cartridge notch
specs.镜头: Rollei Tessar f=23mm f/2.8 - f/16 (focusing 1 meter to infinity)
specs.快门: electronically controlled Rollei-Prontor leaf shutter (continuous speeds from 4 - 1/250 sec.)
specs.曝光测光: CdS photo-resistor measures light for aperture-priority automatic exposure (manually set aperture)
specs.英文简介: The Rollei E110 is the "budget" version of the Rollei A110.
